title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
description: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks. The suspected gunman has been apprehended.
text:
French President Emmanuel Macron has labelled a gun attack in a Parisian suburb that killed one person. And injured five others "a racist terrorist attack". Macron said the attack was a "turning point in the life of our Republic.

And our nation", the first time there had ever been a random racial killing like this. The attack unfolded over some 15 minutes, with the attacker opening fire from his car, first in Trappes, to the south-west of Paris. And then in nearby La VerriÃ¨re, appearing to target people of migrant origin.

Macron said while visiting the scene of the attack that people had been targeted over their skin colour or religion. And urged the public not to give an inch in the face of what he called "ideologies taking root".
